name: Publish new version
description: Admin action that publishes a new version of a product's IFC model with release notes.
heading: Publish new version
intro: Buyers of this product see a "New version" badge and these notes in My models & files. Upload the new files to the product first.
dateHelp: YYYY-MM-DD. Buyers who ordered before this day see the badge.
